summary: Iter82 Business UI rebuild — comprehensive functional QA PASS. Backend regression: 14/15 pytest pass (1 pre-existing time-sensitive failure in test_04_business_event_create_and_filters unrelated to iter82 changes — see below). Frontend full mobile business journey: Onboarding (single teal Get Started CTA, no old Business button) -> /account-type (exactly 2 cards: Personal + Business) -> Business card -> /register?type=business (Business badge active, 'Create your Business account' title) -> business-setup resumes at step 4 Verify (business profile seeded via POST /api/business/me) with 'X of 6' step counter and labeled dot progress -> 'Send me the link' works (biz-computer-link text changes to 'Link sent — check your email', verified backend generates single-use token via test_iter81_business_secure_link.py) -> submit verification -> step 5 Subscription card ($5.99 Business Full Access + all 10 features + Subscribe Now) -> subscribe -> step 6 Verification Pending (biz-pending + biz-finish present + 'Need to complete more details?' link back to step 4) -> Business Dashboard shows blue 'Pending Review' verification card, 2x2 stats grid (0/0/0/-), blue Create Event, empty state 'You haven't hosted an event yet.' + 'Create Your First Event' button. Approval flow: admin API POST /control/businesses/{id}/verification {action:'approve'} -> reload -> ONE-TIME success screen at /business-verified (biz-verified-title 'Your business is verified!', blue check circle, 'Go to Dashboard' CTA) -> click -> dashboard shows GREEN 'Verified' card -> subsequent reload does NOT show success screen again (biz_verified_seen AsyncStorage flag persisted). Mobile tab order confirmed Home/Events/Insights/Notifications/Profile via screenshot; Events tab (Active/Completed/Cancelled) and Insights tab both render without error. Desktop /business/dashboard @ 1366x800: dark navy sidebar (Overview active) + Orrbbit topbar with BUSINESS pill + avatar (BizQAce02), welcome header with business name+check+address, View Public Profile + Create Event buttons work (Create Event -> /business/events/create with 'BUSINESS HOSTED EVENT' banner and cobalt category chip active), 4 KPIs, two-column layout Upcoming Events + Recent Notifications. Personal path regression: /account-type Personal -> /how-location-works (confirmed). Control queue: GET /api/control/businesses?status=Pending%20Review correctly returns seeded biz before approval. All requested testIDs present and functional.

minor.issue: Timezone-sensitive test flake: 'today' host_type=business nearby filter uses UTC date. Test creates biz event at now+3h; when run within 3h of UTC-midnight it crosses into tomorrow UTC and the assertion 'QA Biz Networking Night' in today filter fails. Run was at 23:14 UTC (test event start 02:14 UTC next day). PRE-EXISTING and unrelated to Iter82 UI changes. Fix suggestion: skip test or clamp start_h so it stays inside UTC today, e.g. start_h = 1 or set explicit start_datetime for today filter check.

issues: Non-blocking console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on web — use boxShadow (repeats each screen). Also 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents' on the (business) home. Cosmetic; carried over from prior iterations.

rca_of_issue: test_business_platform::test_04 failure RCA: line 149 creates biz event with start_datetime = datetime.now(UTC) + 3h. The nearby 'today' filter (backend business.py events/nearby ?date=today) filters by UTC calendar day. When run between 21:00 UTC and 24:00 UTC, start_datetime falls into the NEXT UTC day and is correctly excluded from 'today' — assertion at line 171 fails. Reproduction: run at 23:14 UTC (as this suite did). Mitigation: either (a) freeze start_datetime to same-day UTC ('now + 30min' capped so date_utc == today), or (b) add pytest xfail marker when now.hour >= 21, or (c) mock server clock.
